news.title: Paramount and state AGs settle lawsuit, allowing Warner Bros. merger to proceed
news.description: The antitrust lawsuit threatened to delay Paramount's acquisition until mid-2027 and to cost the company hundreds of millions of dollars in fees.

news.title: White House TV pool won't cover Trump after press ban: CNN
news.description: The decision comes as CNN, MS NOW and Politico said they are suing Trump to overturn his new ban of those three media outlets from the White House.
